title: Handoff
description: One agent passing work to another. Referenced by triage-result and verdict rather than emitted alone. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

reason.description: Why this role and not the current one. Names the constraint the receiving role owns.

blocking.description: true when the sender may not proceed until the receiver has answered. The registry keeper and the shape classifier are blocking by design: a number reserved after the fact, or the wrong template, cannot be corrected cheaply later.

context_refs.description: Paths or record ids the receiver needs. Paths are repository-relative; a path under a home directory is not portable and is rejected by the agent-file check.
